This directory holds a Python library for styled terminal output. Printing styled text with soft wrapping turned on leaves the style active across the line break, so in a real terminal the background colour bleeds into the beginning of the next printed line. Reproduce it with:

```python
from rich.console import Console

console = Console(color_system="standard", width=80, force_terminal=True)
with console.capture() as capture:
    console.print("soft wrap is on", style="blue on white", soft_wrap=True)
    console.print("Next line")
print(repr(capture.get()))
```

In the captured text the style is reset only after the newline, so the newline itself is still inside the styled span. With soft wrapping off, the reset comes before the newline. Make the soft-wrap path do the same, so each styled line is closed before its line break.
